description: Defines the interface and data structures for the Network Error Logging (NEL) service, including policies, request details, and storage mechanisms.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService
classes.description: Interface for managing network error logging policies, handling headers, reporting errors, and managing storage.

classes.name: PersistentNelStore
classes.description: Abstract class for persistent storage of NEL policies.

classes.name: NelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key representing a (NIK, origin) pair for NEL policies.

classes.name: WildcardNelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key for wildcard policies applicable to domains and subdomains.

classes.name: NelPolicy
classes.description: Represents a NEL policy with associated parameters.

classes.name: RequestDetails
classes.description: Contains details of a network error for reporting.

classes.name: SignedExchangeReportDetails
classes.description: Contains details of a signed exchange report.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate NetworkErrorLoggingService with optional persistent store.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Processes a received NEL header for a given origin and network anonymization key.

methods.name: OnRequest
methods.description: Queues a network error report based on request details.

methods.name: RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes browsing data for origins matching a filter.

methods.name: RemoveAllBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes all browsing data related to origin policies.

methods.name: SetReportingService
methods.description: Sets the reporting service used for queuing reports.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the NEL service, preventing further processing.

methods.name: SetClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom clock for testing expiration and timing.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns a value representing current policies and status.

methods.name: GetPolicyKeysForTesting
methods.description: Returns current policy keys, including expired ones, for testing.

methods.name: GetPersistentNelStoreForTesting
methods.description: Returns the persistent store instance for testing.

methods.name: GetReportingServiceForTesting
methods.description: Returns the reporting service instance for testing.
